# 0.4.2 - Startup state for every receiver family

Receivers now report their state right after the ESP starts. Before, only the
RX-V1600 and RX-V1900 profiles did; on the other families power, input, volume
and similar entities stayed `off` or `unknown` until something changed on the
receiver.

## Highlights

- Every profile reads the receiver's configuration reply at startup, using the
  layout in the matching RS-232C manual: RX-Vx500, RX-Vx600, RX-Vx700,
  RX-Vx800 and RX-V1900.
- The RX-Vx700 and RX-Vx800 profiles also read the decoder mode, the speaker
  relays, the speaker B assignment and the Zone 2 amplifier. The RX-Vx500
  profile reads Zone 2, the tuner and the speaker relays.
- The RX-Vx500 layout differs from the others (power, Pure Direct and the
  night mode parameter sit elsewhere, and DT123 is a speaker level), so it has
  its own decoder.
- The RX-V1600 and RX-V1900 layouts, which were checked on hardware, are
  unchanged.

The RX-Vx500, RX-Vx700 and RX-Vx800 layouts follow the manuals and are not
confirmed on hardware yet. If one of these receivers still shows `unknown` at
startup, please open an issue with a UART log (`logger: level: VERY_VERBOSE`
and `uart: debug`) from boot.

## Upgrade Notes

- No option changed; `v0.4.1` configurations keep working. Change the
  `external_components` source to `@v0.4.2`.
